Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 96. Category: form. Ultra Instinct.

Godly Transformation
The ultimate defensive ability, though incomplete.
The user’s body will react to protect itself without the
consent or thought of the user. This ability was once
thought impossible to mortals.
Increase your Power by 4
You deal an additional 2d4 to all damage
Increase your Movement Speed by 30 ft.
You gain an additional +3 to your AC.
You gain an additional reaction that can be used for
maneuvers
Drains 4 stamina at the end of your turn. While in
this form you may not use techniques unless they
have at least 1 mastery rank.
Your first 3 times entering this form happen when
you would hit zero hit points you instead awaken in this
form regaining 50% of your Hp and Ki. This form then
lasts until your HP, KI, or Stamina reaches 0.
On your 4th Transformation, you instead enter
Completed Ultra Instinct and can then unlock the ability
to enter this form at will after a dedicated training arc.
